name: Cathay Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Cathay Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in Taiwan and internationally. It operates in two segments, Investment and Development of Real Estate, and Construction. The company constructs residential and commercial buildings for rental and sale.
